# SD13-E5 Ranger level 3 hybrid chassis baseline fixture.
# Represents a deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Ranger level 3 identity as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity
# values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and
# bonus-feat) and stays a single-class, level-3 hybrid baseline, mirroring the
# level-2 fixture's shape with the class level swapped.
#
# Level 3 adds one new deterministic choice selection: Favored Terrain
# (choice:ranger_favored_terrain -> terrain:forest), the PF1 Core Rulebook's other
# 3rd-level Ranger "Special" entry alongside Endurance. Endurance itself is an
# automatic bonus-feat grant with no player choice involved, so it needs no
# choice-slot. Favored Terrain is a genuine player choice of terrain type, drawn from
# Table: Ranger Favored Terrains (Cold, Desert, Forest, Jungle, Mountain, Plains,
# Planes, Swamp, Underground, Urban, Water); Forest is an arbitrary but deterministic
# pick among those eleven legal options. This fixture carries forward the same
# combat-style selections (Archery, Point-Blank Shot) from the level-2 fixture
# unchanged, since combat-style's own bonus feat is a one-time 2nd-level grant, not
# re-granted at 3rd level.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-ranger-level3
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:ranger:3
ability=strength:16
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:14
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:8
feat=feat:power_attack
skill=skill:survival:1
equipment=item:chain_shirt:equipped_worn_active
equipment=item:longsword:equipped_primary_active
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:level_1_character_feat:feat:power_attack
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:strength
choice=choice:ranger_favored_enemy:enemy:humanoid_orc
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style:style:archery
choice=choice:ranger_combat_style_bonus_feat:feat:point_blank_shot
choice=choice:ranger_favored_terrain:terrain:forest
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-13-core-class-race-roster-and-level-10-progression-matrix/artifacts/sd13-e3-r5-paladin-and-ranger-hybrid-chassis-baseline-execution-handoff-2026-07-01.md
